The transformation is a nitro-to-amine reduction, breaking the N–O bond of a nitro group and forming a primary amine. To find the template, we will query the template catalog for reactions that break an N–O bond and form a primary amine. First, we retrieve the list of functional groups to know the exact naming used for nitro and amine groups.</thought>
